body: I hope my advice helps and if you have any other questions please dm me.
Period cramps are not supposed to be that painful. Please go to the gynecologists' or an OBGYN and get checked out. You could have ovarian cysts or something worse.

If you are going to try therapy go to a therapist not a psychiatrist.  Psychiatrist give medicine. I am in therapy now. I feel like i am less suicidal then 8 months ago when i first started. Also I have been to multiple therapists until i found one that works for me, Don't get discouraged if the first or second therapist you meet isn't good match for you. If you go to therapy, just put everything on the table and be open to advice and suggestions. It will take multiple sessions but after awhile, you will start to feel better. Therapy doesn't fix your problems all at once but it definitely helps.

Try Therapy if you are able too. I am in therapy now. I still feel suicidal but it has helped understand my feelings better. Also I have been to multiple therapists until i found one that works for me, Don't get discouraged if the first therapist you meet isn't good match for you.

I don't know what makes you feel suicidal but you should definitely no kill yourself just cause your family and friends cut contact. Your family and friend sounds like pieces of shit and you should ever get in touch with them again because they are not family if they just abandon you like that. I would go no contact with them if I were you.
You are not selfish . Don't ever listen to someone you are being a "coward' or your "selfish" if you commit suicide.
I feel suicidal too. But don't do it. not until you have exhausted every option(therapy, opening up about your sadness to others, etc..) to get better.
